source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia ՀՕ-124-Ն (arlis.am redaction 23.12.2022-06.04.2023; owner confirmed current 22 Nov 2026). Quotes and article reading in docs/legal/PRE_REVIEW.md. Lawyer must confirm.
basis: Art. 114(1)(2): termination at the employer's initiative is prohibited «աշխատողի արձակուրդում գտնվելու ժամանակահատվածում»; 114(1)(2.1): with pregnant women until one month after the end of maternity leave. Art. 114(3): liquidation of the organisation is not restricted. Official checklist N 5.1 question 25.

title.hy: Գործատուի նախաձեռնությամբ լուծումը համընկնում է արձակուրդի հետ (114-րդ հոդված՝ արգելված է)
title.ru: Увольнение по инициативе работодателя пришлось на отпуск (ст. 114: запрещено)
title.en: Employer termination falls inside a leave (Art. 114: prohibited)

edge_cases: Checks annual leave and maternity leave records (maternity: plus one month after the last day). Leave end is a lower bound: days are counted as calendar days, so the rule never over-flags.
Not modelled: sick leave (114(1)(1)), pregnancy before leave (2.1), caring for a child under one year (2.2), strike, other 114(1) points: no data.
